GAUNT.gloss: very thin especially from disease or hunger or cold
GAUNT.definition: Very thin especially from disease or hunger or cold.
GAUNT.example: A nightmare population of gaunt men and skeletal boys.

AUNT.gloss: the sister of your father or mother
AUNT.definition: The sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle.

TUNA.gloss: tropical American prickly pear of Jamaica
TUNA.definition: Tropical American prickly pear of Jamaica.

GUN.gloss: a weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity
GUN.definition: A weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity (especially from a metal tube or barrel).

GUT.gloss: the part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus
GUT.definition: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.

TAN.gloss: a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun
TAN.definition: A browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun.

TAG.gloss: attach a tag or label to
TAG.definition: Attach a tag or label to.

ANT.gloss: social insect living in organized colonies
ANT.definition: Social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers.

TUNG.gloss: Chinese tree bearing seeds that yield tung oil
TUNG.definition: Chinese tree bearing seeds that yield tung oil.
